Marissa — thanks for the context and clear proposal. I support a limited commercial exception here given strategic value and ARR profile, on the following conditions: 

1) Discount: up to 10% committed discount off list for the duration of the term (no retroactive credits).
2) Price lock: firm for first 24 months as requested.
3) Uplift cap: 3% p.a. after month 24, with an aggregate cap not to exceed 6% over the full 3-year period (to limit compounding).
4) Renewal protection: include explicit right for HelioSoft to terminate with 60 days’ notice if materially worse commercial terms are applied at renewal; Legal to craft narrow language to avoid open-ended precedent.
5) Legal sign-off required on final language and on any carve-outs for US federal contracts.
6) Deal desk to codify billing and ASC revenue treatment; Karthik to confirm deferred recognition approach.
